decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis still has a page of its own and builds directly on the firm's core geo-data and energy tariff knowledge, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it.

The regional electricity tariff calculator has dropped to a mere mention, but it sits close to the firm's core tariff-calculation competence and is likely being folded into the platform rather than abandoned, while similar gas and energy calculators were already removed.

The regional area definition tool is now only mentioned, but it is a foundational component of the firm's location-based offerings and draws on knowledge it already holds, so keeping it is more likely than dropping it.
